title: Phone to Phone Transfer
keep: Keep a copy on this computer (backup folder)
unauthorized: USB debugging not allowed (confirm the prompt on the phone screen)
found: Phones found: {n}. From: {src}, to: {dst}. Check and press “Transfer”.
need_two: Two phones with USB debugging enabled are needed. Connect both, confirm the prompt on each screen and press “Refresh”.
st_scan: Refreshing the gallery on the new phone…
scan_done: The gallery on the new phone has been refreshed.
backup_removed: The copy on the computer has been deleted.
no_room_phone: Not enough free space on the new phone: {need} MB needed, {free} MB free. Nothing was copied.
no_room_pc: Not enough free space on this computer: {need} MB needed, {free} MB free. Nothing was copied.
no_contacts: Contacts: none found in the phone's storage (they may be kept in a Google account; then they appear after you sign in).
contacts_done: Contacts: {n}. The file contacts.vcf is in Downloads on the new phone. If the import window did not open, open this file on the phone and choose Contacts.
apps_count: Apps: {all} on the old phone, {have} already on the new one, installing {todo}.
apps_failed_list: Install these from the app store: {list}
verify_hint: Some apps were blocked by the new phone's own install check (Google Play Protect). This program does not switch that check off; install those apps from the store.
adb_ask:
The Android tool “adb” (Google platform-tools) was not found on this computer.

Download it from Google now (about 7 MB)?
adb_manual: adb is needed: download “SDK Platform-Tools” from developer.android.com, put the platform-tools folder next to this program and start it again.
